correctness.rationale: Exact three-orbit singular-value decompositions yield rational inverse-square costs for all \(n\ge3\), \(\(t>0\)\). The matched/same difference is a positive denominator times a sixth-degree polynomial with exactly one positive root by Descartes sign analysis. The unmatched orbit is eliminated by monotone nonsingular M-matrix resolvents for \(0<t<1\) and an all-positive coefficient polynomial in n-3,t-1 for \(t\ge1\). A Taylor polynomial certificate establishes theta_n=1/2-3/(4n^3)-3/(8n^4)+O(\(n^{-5}\)). Exact rational calculations demonstrate a strict disagreement for \(n=3,t=9/20\). Supplied verifier has 500 exact grounded-matrix comparisons, symbolic polynomial and asymptotic tests; finite checks are not the infinite proof. Risk: implementation/algebra transcription; independent direct grounded construction mitigates but does not confer independent review.

Neither a minor numerical gain nor an arbitrary family truncation; the result is complete across all \(n\ge3\) and real \(\(t>0\)\) for the stated objective. Limits: no result for arbitrary heterogeneity or budgets.
